look: Dawn heath stalker, camouflage waxed hood
prompt: A 16mm film frame of a single nature documentary presenter crouched in tall wet grass on a misty heath at dawn, shot on a long telephoto lens: visible grain, shallow focus, slight gate weave. Use the attached image only for the mask's ring-and-triangle layout. His hood is brown-and-olive camouflage-print waxed canvas, one smooth unbroken surface from crown to collar. A thin cream-white ring traces the outer edge of the face area like an oval frame; well inside it, upper right of the picture over his left eye, sits a small flat solid red triangle with rounded corners. Khaki safari shirt, sleeves rolled over a long-sleeved base layer, a many-pocketed gilet, radio mic pack on his belt, lavalier wire up his chest, binoculars swinging. Tan suede gardening gloves run under his cuffs. Head and shoulders square to the lens, one gloved finger raised for silence, the other hand pointing back at an abandoned bank safe lying on its side in the bracken. Low golden sun behind, glowing mist, cool shadows, a boom pole edge poking into frame. Thanks.

look: Floodlit touchline pundit, turquoise ripstop hood
prompt: A broadcast frame grab of a single lower-league football pundit on the muddy touchline of a small ground on a rainy weeknight, shot waist-up from further down the touchline on a big box zoom lens: telephoto compression, raindrops on the lens hood. Use the attached image only for the mask's ring-and-triangle layout. His hood is bright turquoise ripstop nylon, rain-beaded, one smooth unbroken surface tucked into his zipped collar. A thin cream-white ring traces the outer edge of the face area like an oval frame; well inside it, upper right of the picture over his left eye, sits a small flat solid red triangle with rounded corners. Long padded touchline coat zipped to the chin, plain two-colour striped scarf, earpiece wire. Padded black goalkeeper gloves with a small ring-and-triangle patch on the back hold a stick mic with a plain square flag at chin height, dripping. Square to camera, mid-verdict, as a pitch sprinkler swings round and soaks him from the side. Hard white floodlights, cold rain streaks, a thin crowd as soft dots in the stand. Thanks.
